resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives a 1922 camp and a 1939 L-4 cab; the Forest Lookouts page gives a 1930 entry for the first Superior Building Company pre-cut lookout house built on the Flathead Forest. The sources do not reconcile these dates. The story gives both. A search for the Superior Building Company found no corroborating source.

notes_for_editor: Build dates conflict: a 1922 camp and 1939 L-4 cab on firelookout.com versus a 1930 Superior Building Company pre-cut house on the Forest Lookouts page. The 1930 entry is unverified. Two searches found nothing specific to Bruce Ridge, and no staffing or fire records were found. The removal date is unknown. No source describes the site today or its access.
